channel.name: The Money Rule
channel._tags_note: Channel-level YouTube tags. publish.py appends distinctive words from the video title to these.
channel._profile_note: Used by channel_profile.py for the About page and banner. country is where the channel is registered, not who it targets.
description: One rule per video, explained in plain English.
Compound interest, index funds, debt, inflation, taxes — the mechanics behind money, broken down with real numbers you can check and sources you can look up.
No hype. No stock tips. No get-rich promises. Just the rule, why it works, and where it stops working.
Everything here is educational content, not financial advice. For your own situation, speak to a qualified professional.

branding._note: The intro is generated once and cached in assets/. It rebuilds automatically when the name or tagline changes.

models._note: llm_provider: 'kimi'. script_model and verify_model use kimi-k3 (general-purpose, better creative writing). visual_model uses code-highspeed for structured JSON output.

voice._note: engine: 'edge' = free Microsoft neural TTS, no API key. 'elevenlabs' = better prosody, needs ELEVENLABS_API_KEY + voice_id.

pipeline._max_stock_ratio_note: Reused-content guardrail: max share of shots allowed to be raw Pexels stock. Above this, GATE 3 fails and the video must lean more on original charts/cards.
